name: Cuadrícula de Artefactos de Video
algorithm: Video Artifact Grid — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method detects grid-like artifacts for video deepfake detection:

1. **Grid Patrón Detección**: The method searches for periodic grid-like artifacts in the spatial domain using autocorrelation and Fourier analysis. Grid artifacts appear as periodic intensity patterns at specific spatial frequencies — common artifacts from GAN generators using transposed convolution or pixel shuffle upsampling.

2. **Transposed Convolution Artefacto Identification**: When GANs use transposed convolution for upsampling, "checkerboard artifacts" appear at the stride frequency. The method specifically detects these stride-related grid patterns using frequency-domain analysis targeting the known artifact frequencies.

3. **Bloque Grid Detección**: Video compression creates 8×8 or 16×16 block boundaries. The method distinguishes between legitimate compression block grids and generation artifact grids by analyzing grid frequency, grid phase, and grid-content relationship. Generation grids are typically at different frequencies than compression grids.

4. **Espacial Grid Localization**: Detected grid artifacts are mapped spatially. Grid artifacts appearing only in face regions (not in background) strongly indicate face generation. The spatial extent of grid artifacts reveals the boundaries of generated content.

5. **Temporal Grid Estabilidad**: Compression block grids are temporally stable (fixed grid phase). Generation grids may be temporally unstable — shifting phase between frames as the generator produces each frame independently. The method distinguishes stable (compression) from unstable (generation) grids for forensic classification.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante video artifact grid analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva
